corrections.text: The Context section states: "Both sets of advisories describe the same underlying condition for exposure: a dev server reachable over the network through --host or the server.host option." This is not accurate for all three October advisories. Two of the three (file exposure outside server.fs.allow, and first-four-byte disclosure via ?vite-wasm-instance) do require the dev server to be exposed to the network with --host or server.host. The third, GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw (cross-origin script execution), lists different conditions in its Impact section -- an unchanged request URL passed to server.transformIndexHtml, an inline module script in the transformed HTML, and sensitive values or critical actions reachable from the page -- and does not list network exposure via --host/server.host as a condition.
